clue.text: Famous Persian king beset by ten former wives

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten

indicators.note: to be beset by others is to be surrounded by them, so the king sits inside

parts.note: exes are former spouses
R, from Rex, is the standard abbreviation for a king

explanation.surface: A celebrated ruler of Persia is hounded by ten women he once married.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Famous Persian king' reads as the whole definition, but 'king' is R, set inside X plus EXES.
explanation.definitionFit: The ruler who invaded Greece in 480 BC is among the best-known of all the Achaemenid monarchs.

clue.text: Greek historian and general work hard when caught in gas

indicators.note: something caught in another thing is held inside it, so the gas surrounds the rest

parts.note: xenon is a noble gas
OP, short for opus, is a work
H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: An ancient Greek scholar-soldier toils hard while trapped in a cloud of gas.
explanation.definitionFit: The Athenian author of the Anabasis both led the Ten Thousand in retreat and wrote history.

clue.text: Free to eat fish? Roe, for example

indicators.note: one piece eating another takes it inside, so the word for free surrounds the fish

parts.note: to rid is to free
char is a trout-like freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Something is let loose to feed on fish, with roe given as an example.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Roe' looks like fish eggs, fitting the fishy surface, but it is a surname: Richard Roe is the stock fictitious name in English law, partner of John Doe.
explanation.definitionFit: In legal tradition the placeholder litigant called Roe carries that first name, as Doe is called John.

clue.text: Woman deplored knight being lost in love

parts.note: Ena is a woman's name, a crossword favourite

indicators.note: something lost is taken away, so the knight's letter goes from the word before it

parts.note: to have mourned something is to have deplored or lamented it
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A woman lamented that her knight had gone missing while she was smitten.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knight being lost' reads as the woman's grief, but it tells you to drop the knight's letter; the definition is just 'in love'.
explanation.definitionFit: Being smitten or infatuated means having fallen for someone, the sense of the participle here.

clue.text: Pat toils in Blarney

parts.note: to clap someone, on the back say, is to pat them
toils are nets or snares, so a trap

explanation.surface: An Irishman named Pat labours away at sweet-talking flattery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pat' looks like an Irish name to go with Blarney, but it is a verb meaning clap; 'toils' is the noun for snares, not labours.
explanation.definitionFit: Blarney is smooth flattering talk, and the answer is empty, pretentious nonsense of the same kind.

clue.text: Caribbean group has ridden as well as possible

indicators.note: a possible arrangement is one of the ways the letters could go, so they are reordered

explanation.surface: An island chain has been travelled on horseback as well as anyone could manage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possible' rearranges RIDDEN AS WELL AS; 'has' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The chain running from the Virgin Islands to Dominica is a Caribbean archipelago, named for its sheltered position.

clue.text: Caught one sleeping — raised alarm

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means the letters are read upwards, so from bottom to top

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
I is the Roman numeral for one
a nap is a short sleep

explanation.surface: Someone is caught napping and the alarm goes up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns the whole run C, I, NAP upward, giving PANIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Alarm in the sense of sudden fear is the same feeling as frantic terror.

clue.text: Discern changes in void

indicators.note: when a word changes, its letters are shifted into a new order here

explanation.surface: Perceive differences inside an empty space.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changes' rearranges DISCERN; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To void a contract is to annul or revoke it, cancelling it as law permits.

clue.text: Working steadily or quietly resting

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical direction for quietly
someone lying down is resting

explanation.surface: Someone is either toiling steadily or lying quietly at rest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or' looks like it joins two definitions, but it is a link between the definition and the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To ply a trade is to work at it regularly and diligently.

clue.text: Trout may be pleased as Punch

definitions.meaning: trout can be caught by tickling, so a fish might be killed that way

explanation.definitionFit: Being hugely amused or delighted is the idiomatic sense; the literal sense is death by tickling, how poachers catch trout.

clue.text: Rotten centre in a fruit

indicators.note: something rotten has gone bad, so these letters are spoilt into a new order

explanation.surface: Something has rotted in the middle of a piece of fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rotten' rearranges CENTRE IN A.
explanation.definitionFit: This smooth-skinned peach variety is a stone fruit.

clue.text: No saint included in this category?

definitions.text: No saint included in this category?

indicators.note: one thing included in another sits within it, so the saint goes inside the word for no

parts.note: nay is an old word for no

explanation.surface: A question whether any saint could ever be counted among this group.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is also the definition: an unpleasant sort would never include a saint.
explanation.definitionFit: Spiteful, unpleasant people form a class from which the saintly are excluded by nature.

clue.text: Kiss, embracing a business man who's vain

indicators.note: something embracing another holds it inside, so the kiss surrounds the rest

parts.note: a peck is a quick kiss
CO is the abbreviation for company, a business

explanation.surface: A kiss is given while hugging a businessman with a high opinion of himself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a business man' looks like one phrase, but 'man' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The showy bird stands for a strutting, conceited fellow, hence a figurative term for a dandy.

clue.text: Court case about university bridge

indicators.note: one piece about another goes round it, so the court case surrounds the university

parts.note: an action is a lawsuit

explanation.surface: A lawsuit concerns a university's bridge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bridge' suggests a structure over a river, but it is the card game.
explanation.definitionFit: A form of the card game in which players bid for the right to name trumps is named for that bidding.

clue.text: Major removes lid from container

indicators.note: a lid is the top, so the first letter is taken off the word for container

parts.note: a holder is something that contains

explanation.surface: A senior officer takes the lid off a box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Major' looks like an army rank but means senior, as Cato Major is the elder.
explanation.definitionFit: In names, major marks the elder of two of the same name, so it means senior in years.

clue.text: The Spanish fish in Ophir, for instance

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
a dorado is a fish, the dolphinfish

explanation.surface: A Spanish fish swims in the waters of Ophir.
explanation.walkthrough: Ophir is the Biblical land from which Solomon's gold came.
explanation.definitionFit: The Biblical land of gold is an example of a fabled place of riches.

clue.text: I've a sober disposition to overcome

indicators.note: a disposition is an arrangement, so these letters are laid out anew

explanation.surface: Someone claims a sober temperament to conquer temptation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disposition' looks like temperament but signals a rearrangement of I'VE A SOBER.
explanation.definitionFit: To surmount a difficulty is to rise higher than it and not be held back.

clue.text: Outlaw making man hand over money, perhaps

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece handed over another is placed above it

parts.note: he refers to a man
a reward is often a sum of money

explanation.surface: Getting a man to hand over cash, perhaps, turns him into a bandit.
explanation.walkthrough: Hereward the Wake was an English outlaw who resisted the Norman conquest; 'making' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The Saxon rebel of the Fens is remembered as a legendary outlaw.

clue.text: Marries, and gets accepted in orders

indicators.note: something accepted in another is taken inside, so 'and' goes within the word for marries

parts.note: to mate is to pair or marry

explanation.surface: Someone weds and is admitted to holy orders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'orders' suggests religious orders, but it means commands.
explanation.definitionFit: Official commands or instructions are authorised directions.

clue.text: Further progress

definitions.meaning: to further is to promote or help on

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are about moving forward: to promote a cause, and forward movement itself.

clue.text: Cautiously move left in party

indicators.note: one piece in another is set inside it, so left goes within party

parts.note: a side is a party in a dispute

explanation.surface: Someone moves warily away from a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' looks like a verb meaning departed, but it is L.
explanation.definitionFit: To edge furtively or sideways is to move cautiously.

clue.text: See if ice does reform

indicators.note: to reform is to form again, so these letters take a new shape

explanation.surface: A suggestion to look whether ice reforms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' is a bishop's seat, and 'reform' rearranges ICE DOES; 'if' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop's see is the district under his jurisdiction.

clue.text: In the event, talk is cut short

indicators.note: to cut something short is to trim its end, so the last letter goes

parts.note: to discuss is to talk over

explanation.surface: As things turned out, the conversation was ended early.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the event' reads as 'as it happened', but 'the event' is the athletics throwing event; 'In' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The throwing of a heavy disc is a standard field event in athletics.

clue.text: Retire from active service, having no legal force

definitions.meaning: to be sent home as unfit, typically from the forces

explanation.definitionFit: One spelling serves both the verb for discharging a sick soldier and the adjective for void.

clue.text: Look over set-up? True

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece over another sits above it

parts.note: lo is an old word for look

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for set is read upwards

parts.note: to lay something is to set it down

explanation.surface: Someone checks a set-up and finds it honest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns LAY to YAL below LO.
explanation.definitionFit: Being faithful or steadfast is what true means of a friend.

clue.text: Seafood provided by Jack and nobody else

parts.note: a jack tar is a sailor, as is an AB, able seaman
alone means with no one else

explanation.surface: Seafood is served by Jack with no help from anyone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'provided by' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: This edible marine snail is a shellfish delicacy.

clue.text: Knowing one way to preserve city

parts.note: food can be preserved by canning it
NY is New York

explanation.surface: A shrewd way of keeping a city intact.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrewd and astute, especially about money, describes the knowing sort.

clue.text: Stars get together with capital lawyer in the States

parts.note: and means together with
Rome is the Italian capital
a DA is a district attorney in the US

explanation.surface: Celebrities meet up with a big-city American attorney.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stars' suggests celebrities, but it is a constellation; 'get' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The constellation and its galaxy are a group of stars named for the chained princess of myth.

clue.text: Dishonestly get possession of your old secret

parts.note: to steal is to take dishonestly
thy is the old form of your

explanation.surface: Dishonestly acquiring something that is yours of old, by secret means.
explanation.definitionFit: Being covert and furtive is the secret manner of a thief.

clue.text: Celebrity taken in by affable gendarme

indicators.note: the letters are taken in by the following words, which hold them within

explanation.surface: A famous person is fooled by a friendly French policeman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken in by' looks like 'fooled', but marks the letters held in AFFABLE GENDARME.
explanation.definitionFit: A living legend is a famous figure, a celebrity of renown.
